methodology: Expansion checked public employer ATS pages, employer-attributed LinkedIn job posts and identified recruitment ads on September 7, 2026.

Open means the correct role description and an application entry point were observed; indexed_only means job-specific indexed evidence was available but direct content was not readable. Neither status guarantees continued hiring.
Fit assesses overlap with approximately four years of Pega/CSSA, Kafka/REST/SQL and production operations. Adjacent platform or analyst roles are possible/stretch leads, not verified qualifications.

India remote eligibility is stated only where the specific posting names Indian locations. GitLab requires Bengaluru residence; Twilio names five states/territories. The iitjobs remote lead is explicitly unconfirmed by its employer.
Salary objects preserve advertised INR annual amounts and distinguish explicit total CTC from unitemized pay. Undisclosed salary is null and does not establish a ₹20 lakh package.
Jobskey's expired ad is intentionally closed and retained only as historical salary evidence; it must be excluded from actionable-opening totals.
limitations: This is a researched expansion, not an exhaustive census of the full target catalog. It contains no employee/team headcount estimates.
Search-index crawl/posting ages can be stale; relative ages were not converted to calendar dates.
Third-party and LinkedIn employer-attributed posts should be checked against employer recruitment before submission.
None of the unitemized salary ranges establishes fixed pay or take-home pay, and no published range guarantees an individual offer.
Foreign-country remote jobs were not added without a useful, explicit country/work-authorization match; no overseas role was assumed India-eligible.
No applications, recruiter messages, personal-profile queries or contact outreach were performed.
